response.summary: Black Hills Corp.  shares rose on Tuesday after  Microsoft  announced plans to purchase approximately 3,200 acres in Cheyenne, Wyo., to develop a data center.  The project will add to Microsoft’s footprint in the state, as hyperscalers such as  Meta Platforms  have started to build out data centers in Wyoming.  Microsoft already has 11 data centers in the state, with three more currently being built.
